firstPlayerRule: In multiplayer, whoever most recently traveled to a place with fewer than 100 inhabitants goes first.
houseFallback: If nobody qualifies, the timing is tied or unclear, or your group prefers another approach, agree to choose randomly. This is this site’s suggested house rule.
clarifications: Give that player the starting player token and 6 coins. The next player clockwise receives 7 coins; the third and fourth players, if present, receive 8 each.
The token holder takes the first turn, then turns continue clockwise. Each turn chooses an action, advances a ship, and updates the action strips.
Solo play is different: the Wise Eminence receives the starting player token and acts first; the human starts with 7 coins.
